title: Model Pin Card + Profile Snapshot: glancable console flow
creator: Sofia Ramos
description:
Problem: Customers onboarding new model versions struggle to quickly compare performance and cost trade-offs when pinning a version for production. Current console views require multiple clicks between the model version list, detailed perf dossiers, and rollout controls, which slows down ops and increases pinning errors.

Proposal: Introduce a compact 'Model Pin Card' in the version list that surfaces an abridged performance snapshot (latency p50/p95/p99, cost per 1k tokens, sample quality metric), recent run artifacts (sample outputs, failing evals), and a pin action with a lightweight preview and rollout slider. The card should support keyboard quick-pinning, a confirmable audit message, and a one-click link to the full performance profile and rollout history.

Goals: Reduce time-to-pin by 40%, lower accidental pins by surfacing regressions, and increase confidence by making perf signals glanceable during model onboarding and QA.
acceptance_criteria: Model Pin Card appears inline in the Versions table for each version with perf snapshot fields: p50, p95, p99 latency; tokens-per-second; cost-per-1k-tokens; quality score (0-100)
Pin action supports: immediate pin (with confirmation), canary rollout slider (0-100%), pin preview modal showing sample outputs and changelog, and an audit entry recorded to version history
Card includes link to full Performance Profile page and to the Eval set used for displayed metrics
Keyboard shortcuts: focus card with 'v' then 'p' to open pin modal; ESC to cancel
Telemetry: track time from version open -> pin action, number of times perf snapshot was viewed, and pin rollbacks within 24h
Accessibility: card passes contrast and screen-reader label checks; slider operable via keyboard
updates: 2025-02-20: Kickoff meeting with ENG, Design, Research. Agreed scope: inline card, small modal, telemetry events. Blocker: missing perf aggregation API for rolling 24h p99. Assigned ENG-4301 to implement endpoint.
2025-02-25: Design wireframes reviewed. Design asked for two density modes: 'compact' and 'expanded'. PM prefers default compact for version list. Liam to finalize specs.

2025-02-28: Engineering provided trade-off: computing p99 on read path adds 8% wall time to version list fetch. Decided to serve cached perf snapshot updated every 5 minutes. ENG change logged under ENG-4319.
2025-03-02: UX microtest with 6 internal users comparing baseline vs new pin card. Median time-to-pin decreased from 82s to 43s. Report attached.

2025-03-04: Design delivered high-fidelity mocks and a Figma prototype. Implementation plan: Phase 1 (compact card + pin modal + telemetry), Phase 2 (keyboard shortcuts + expanded card + rollout templates).
review_feedback: Design review: Add failure badge when recent evals indicate regression (>=5% quality delta). Use amber accent to draw attention but avoid alarm fatigue.
Security review: Audit trail must include actor, timestamp, previous pinned version, and rollout percentage. No sensitive data in sample outputs shown in preview (mask customer tokens).
Engineering review: Recommend lazy-load of sample outputs in modal to avoid heavy payloads on version list. Agree to cache perf snapshot for 5 minutes.
decisions: Serve perf snapshot via new read-only endpoint that returns pre-aggregated metrics refreshed every 5 minutes
Default card density = compact. Expanded card gated behind user-preference 'Show perf details' in console settings
Pin action will create an audit log entry and trigger a server-side validation that checks compatibility and required secrets before finalizing pin

release_notes: Adds inline Model Pin Card with perf snapshot and quick pin modal. Beta behind 'model_pin_card' feature flag. Tracks telemetry for time-to-pin and rollouts.
